title: Creamy Red Pepper Cashew Dip - it doesn't taste like chicken
byline: Sam Turnbull @ It Doesn't Taste Like Chicken
ldIngredientsRaw: 1 1/2 cups raw cashews, (soaked or boiled (see nots))
1/2 - 1 cup plant-based milk (such as soy or almond)
ldInstructionsRaw: Add the raw cashews, 1/2 cup non-dairy milk, the red pepper, nutritional yeast, garlic, lemon juice, chili powder, and salt to a blender. Combine until smooth, stopping to scrape the sides as needed, and adding up to 1/2 cup more non-dairy milk as needed to reach desired consistency.
